NAME:
   rancher auth - Auth commands

USAGE:
   rancher auth [command] [flags]

COMMANDS:
   delete-token:  Delete cached exec-credential token(s)
   get-token:     Authenticate and print a kubeconfig ExecCredential
   list-tokens:   List cached exec-credential token entries
   login:         Login to a Rancher server
   logout:        Clear stored login credentials for a server
   status:        Verify connectivity and credentials against the current server

FLAGS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
